note: Pre-survey checklist (CP-30). Drafted by the team, to be reviewed with Marsh: the hazards per facility type and the standards each is checked against. Bump `version` on any change; every saved checklist records it. v2: descriptions for Section 8's utility subsections, which showed as a bare heading. v3: every template item is a verb-led check of at most 20 words.

template_details.6/Management Programs: Review the site's maintenance, hot work, housekeeping, change, emergency and contractor programmes, and ask for records showing they are followed.
template_details.7/Construction Narrative: Check walls, roof, frame and floors for materials and combustibility, and note building age, height and alterations.
template_details.7/Construction Table: Record each building's construction class, floor area, storeys and year built.
template_details.7/Compartmentalization and Fire Division: Inspect fire walls and separations, and confirm that openings in them are protected.
template_details.7/Details on Combustible Construction: Look for combustible roof or wall panels, insulation and linings, and record where they are.
template_details.8/Occupancy: Confirm who owns and operates the site and how many people work there, by shift.
template_details.8/Overview: Confirm what the site is used for, its operating hours and its occupancy.
template_details.8/Key Processes: Identify the main processes and check which of them are hazardous.
template_details.8/Key Machinery: Identify critical machinery and equipment, and check how quickly each could be replaced.
template_details.8/Special Hazards: Identify special hazards, their location, and the active and passive protection provided for each.
template_details.8/Power: Check the site's power supply, incoming voltage, feeds and distribution, and record any single point of failure.
template_details.8/Back-up Power: Check generators or UPS, what they serve, and how often they are tested.
template_details.8/Transformer details: Record each transformer's type, rating and oil or dry type, and check its separation from buildings.
template_details.8/Boilers: Check each boiler's type, fuel, pressure, separation, combustion safeguards and inspection records.
template_details.8/Refrigeration / Chillers / Cooling tow: Check refrigeration plant and refrigerant, chillers, and whether cooling tower fill is combustible and protected.
template_details.8/Fuels and energy supplies: Check fuels on site (gas, oil, LPG), quantities, storage locations and emergency shut-offs.
template_details.8/Process water: Confirm where process water comes from, how it is stored and treated, and what stops without it.
template_details.8/Compressed air: Inspect compressors, their location and condition, and confirm which operations depend on compressed air.
template_details.8/Compressed gases: Check gas cylinders and bulk tanks for contents, storage location and whether they are secured.
template_details.8/Waste and effluent treatment: Check how waste and effluent are collected, stored and treated, and where combustible waste builds up.
template_details.8/Other site services: Identify any other utility the site depends on, and confirm what happens if it fails.
template_details.9/Automatic Sprinkler Protection: Check sprinkler system types, coverage and design density for each area.
template_details.9/Special Extinguishing Systems: Identify gaseous, foam or other special extinguishing systems, and confirm what each protects.
template_details.9/Water Supply Details: Check the water sources, tanks and mains that feed fire protection.
template_details.9/Water Supply Test Results: Review the latest water supply test for static and residual pressure, and flow.
template_details.9/Fire / Booster Pump Details: Record each fire pump's type, driver, rating and controller.
template_details.9/Pump Flow Test Data: Review the latest fire pump flow test results against the pump's rated curve.
template_details.9/Manual Firefighting Features: Check fire department distance and response time, hydrant coverage, extinguishers and hose stations or reels.
template_details.9/Fire Alarm Monitoring: Check where alarms are monitored and how quickly they are acted on.
template_details.9/Fire Alarm Details: Check the alarm signalling service, fire panel model, and which alarm signals are monitored.
template_details.10/Location Details: Check the site's location, its surroundings and access for the fire service.
template_details.10/Boundary Exposures: Inspect what lies beyond each boundary (north, east, south, west) and its fire exposure to the site.
template_details.10/Natural Catastrophe Exposures: Check the site's exposure to flood, storm, lightning, earthquake and other natural hazards.
template_details.11/Site Perimeter: Check perimeter fencing and height, vehicle access, entry signage and exterior lighting.
template_details.11/Building Physical Features: Check that ground level windows are secure, and how locks and keys are controlled.
template_details.11/Security Staff / Guards: Confirm on-site guards, visiting patrols and police surveillance, and whether rounds are recorded and how often.
template_details.11/CCTV: Check CCTV coverage, recording and monitoring, and whether cameras cover entrances and the site perimeter.
template_details.11/Intruder Detection: Test intruder detection: motion sensors, beams and door contacts, and where alarms report.
template_details.11/Access Monitored: Check whether ID cards or badges are used and how visitors are monitored.
template_details.11/Other Security Programs / Controls: Review other security controls: screening, safes, equipment storage, parking, cash handling and emergency response.
template_details.12/Site: Ask how long rebuilding would take, what alternatives exist, and what happens if access is denied.
template_details.12/Operations, Plant & Processes: Identify bottlenecks, critical spares, seasonality, alternatives and subcontracting options for operations and processes.
template_details.12/Utilities, Infrastructure & Services: Identify IT and communications systems, critical suppliers and key customers, and any contractual penalties.
template_details.12/Business Continuity / Disaster Recove: Confirm a business continuity plan exists, what it covers, and when it was last reviewed and tested.
